notes.title: SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 5.2.0 Released
notes.content:
Dear Pilots;

First and foremost, we wish all our players a happy and prosperous New Year! Thank you for your continued support and feedback – your contributions help us shape the universe of SpaceBourne 2. Here are the latest updates and fixes to start the year off right:

[b]SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 5.2.0[/b]

[h3]New Features & Changes:[/h3]

[b]Multilingual Support Reintroduced[/b]

The game’s multilingual support has been redefined. As of now, the following languages are available:

[b]•	English
•	Turkish
•	German
•	French
•	Italian
•	Russian
•	Polish
•	Spanish[/b]

Additionally, the following languages are currently in the translation phase:

[b]•	Chinese Simplified
•	Chinese Traditional
•	Japanese
•	Hungarian
•	Portuguese (Brazilian)[/b]

Some translations have been assisted by AI, which may result in occasional grammatical errors or awkward phrasing. However, we are opening in-game texts to all early access players.
We would greatly appreciate your help in correcting any mistakes you notice in your native language through  [url=https://crowdin.com/project/spacebourne2]Crowdin[/url]. Your feedback will directly improve the game's localization.

[b]Class Overhaul and Balancing[/b]
In-game subclasses have been reorganized and their effectiveness has been enhanced. The starting classes have been expanded with more content, and their impact on gameplay has been significantly increased.

Note: If you are using an old save, the game will automatically select the class closest to the one you previously chose.

[b]Perk Adjustments and Additions[/b]
Non-functional and unbalanced perks have been reworked. New and more effective perks have been added to the game to enhance gameplay.

[b]Scanner System Update[/b]
The scanner system has been improved, and new points of interest that can be discovered through scanning in space have been added. (This feature is still in development, and additional functionalities will be introduced in future updates.)

[b]Faction Battle Balancing and Tracking[/b]
Galaxy wars and faction battles have been rebalanced. Additionally, ongoing faction battles are now added to the player’s journal as missions for better tracking and engagement.

[b]Save System Improvements[/b]
The save system has been optimized for better performance. Autosaves have been added at all critical points throughout the game.

[h3]Bug Fixes:
[/h3]
[i]Reported by players as follows:
[/i]

[list]
[*] Nova Squad can trigger mines that I set on the ground.

notes.title: SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 5.1.0 Released
notes.content:
Dear Pilots,

We are steadily progressing towards the full release of SpaceBourne 2! As we continue to enhance the game, your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify and resolve issues. With this latest update, we’ve addressed numerous bugs, implemented new features, and polished various aspects of gameplay. Thank you for your patience and support as we move closer to delivering the ultimate SpaceBourne 2 experience!

Here’s a comprehensive list of the resolved issues and improvements:

[b]SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 5.1.0[/b]

[h3]New Features & Changes:[/h3]

[b]Full Gamepad Support:[/b] SpaceBourne 2 now offers full gamepad support. The game can be played from start to finish without ever needing to use a keyboard.

[list]
[*] New keybind system.
[*] New combo system.
[*] New auto-aim and movement mechanics.
[*] New widget navigation system.
[*] New preset and preset saving system.
[*] New Runtime button indicators were added to the game.
[*] Many other features were added to enhance gamepad controls.

[b]Note[/b]: To perfect gamepad support, we’ve temporarily limited multi-device HOTAS support. I appreciate your understanding.

[/list]
[b]Miner’s Guild Contracts:[/b] The Miner’s Guild now features continuously updated trade-based contracts. Ores obtained from mining are now much more valuable.

[b]New Miner’s Guild Contract Consoles[/b]: Dedicated contract consoles have been added to the interior of the Miner’s Guild.

[b]Steam Achievements:[/b] SpaceBourne 2 now supports Steam Achievements.

[b]Steam Cloud Save:[/b] SpaceBourne 2 now supports Steam Cloud Save.

[b]Steam Leaderboards: [/b]The Steam leaderboard system has been integrated into the game. A new leaderboard interface has been added to the pause menu for easy access.

[b]New Station Interiors:[/b] Mining bases, research bases, and factories now have fully designed interiors. Players can now enter and explore the inside of every station.

[b]Swimming Added: [/b]Swimming mechanics have been introduced for the water surfaces on planetary terrains.

[b]Stats and Perks Overhauled:[/b] Stats and perks have been rebalanced. Tier 3 versions of many perks have been added to the game. The issue where high-level players couldn’t progress their perk statuses has been resolved.

[u][b]We strongly recommend starting the story from the beginning to fully enjoy the updated experience.

[b]SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 4.2.0[/b]

[h3]Dungeons Overhauled and Improved[/h3]

[b]Dungeon Levels Adjusted[/b]: All dungeon levels and difficulty scaling have been revamped, ensuring a smoother progression experience.

[b]T6 Dungeon Items Introduced: [/b]A new item tier, T6, has been added, significantly more powerful than previous tiers and crucial for end-game content.

notes.title: SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 4.1.0 Released
notes.content:
[b]SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 4.1.0 [/b]

[h3]New Features And Changes: [/h3]

We've gathered all the feedback from our players and have completely rewritten the entire family and faction system based on it.

[b]New Faction Stats:[/b]

Four new faction stats have been added to the game:

[list]
[*]  Diplomatic Power: Determined by a faction's relationships with other factions.
[*]  Economic Power: Determined by the stations and systems a faction owns, and the traffic those systems generate.
[*] Military Power: Based on the strategic locations owned and the military strength of a faction.
[*] Family Power: Calculated based on the total power a faction holds in the galaxy.
[*] Leader Power: Determined by the successes and decisions of a faction's leader.
[*] Factions now base all their decisions and actions on these values, enhancing and renewing the AI behaviors.

[/list]

[b]New Faction and Diplomacy Feature – “Trade Routes”:[/b]

Factions can now form trade agreements with each other. Following these agreements, trade routes are established between the parties, and trade ships dynamically follow these routes to complete their trades.

[b]Ambush the Trade Ships :[/b]

One of the most requested features, Trade Convoys and Seamless Space to Ground Battles, has been added. Players can now ambush trade ships along these routes, breach their hulls, and engage in seamless face-to-face combat to loot containers.

[b]New Faction and Diplomacy Feature – “Leaders”:[/b]

Every faction now has leaders, such as Mayors or Generals in every system and station. These leaders can make autonomous decisions that enhance their faction's power. Players can encounter them in various locations, such as the stations they manage. Additionally, winning battles may now result in capturing these leaders if they are present at the station, disabling them, taking them prisoner, and even selling them as slaves, thereby disrupting the power balance of the factions.

[b]More Dynamic AI Diplomacy:
[/b]
AI factions can now develop relationships amongst themselves, forging new agreements and opening new trade routes.

[b]Player Faction Improvements:[/b]

[b]New Currency: POWER[/b]

A new currency, Power now balances all actions of the player faction. Every activity earns Power, and every advancement requires it, making the progression more balanced and the game more challenging.

[b]New Player Faction Trade Agreements:[/b]
Player factions can now make trade agreements with friendly factions to earn money.

[b]New Faction Path Variable:[/b]
The path chosen for a player's faction now has more significant implications. For instance, a Faction on the Chaos path gains more power from plundering a station, whereas a Faction on the Harmony path gains less power and must consider Faction support.

[b]New Enemy Class: "Space Boss Ships"[/b]
Space now features dozens of procedurally generated bosses with multiple abilities, replacing all bounty targets in bounty missions with these bosses.

[b]Mothership Improvements:[/b]
The player mothership and its system have been completely overhauled. Motherships now have subsystems which players manage in real-time, influencing the course of battles through strategic subsystem adjustments.

We will be introducing new Mothership weapons in future updates to make motherships even more complex.

[b]Sound and Music Updates:[/b]

Unique music and atmospheric sounds have been added for all stations.

The Russian Language has been updated.

[h3]**BUG FIXES:**[/h3]
Reported by players as follows:

[list]
[*] - I can no longer call my Mothership. I am in the correct system and station, but it will not respond my call via the Ship Manager interface.
[*] - Some planets' scalers are too large and can engulf surrounding stations, or when I warp to a nearby station, it directly lands me on the planet.
[*] - "The Constructor" mission does not update from " Wait for Jack" part.
[*] - Anti-missile flares are launched from the middle of the ship forward.
[*] -When assigning a general as the leader of a new house, the general slot is permanently deleted.

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]:[i] We fixed this bug, but had to remove all generals from their slots and refresh the slots to correct imbalances in save files that were affected. Therefore, if you encounter this issue and find the general slots empty when you load your game, you need to reassign them from the "Ready to Assign" section.[/i]

[*] - Capital ships are capable of buying trade goods from Trade Hubs or Industrial Complexes, which disrupts the trade mechanics.
[*] - Star systems assigned to sub-houses (vassals) in the Atlas are displayed as belonging to no one (without a mini-portrait of my vassal).
[*] - House Zerat should have a Research Station named Aldon in the Valtoros (N2) system, but it is not there. NOTE: We identified 6 space stations missing like this and have corrected these errors.

notes.title: SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 4.0.0 Released
notes.content:
[b]SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 4.0.0 [/b]

[h3]New Features And Changes: [/h3]

[list]
[*] - Castle sieges have been added to the game. Players can now capture castles on planet surfaces in real-time and manage RTS sieges.

[*] - 20 different castle types, each uniquely designed by hand, have been added to planet surfaces.

[*] - The faction soldier system has been revamped. Faction soldiers are now categorized into Space Forces and Ground Forces.

[*] - Army sizes have been expanded. Each army can now include up to 10 generals.

[*] - New types of ground forces soldiers have been added to the game, including Elite Soldiers, Snipers, Medics, Tanks, and Mechs.

[*] - Faction space battles have been redesigned from the ground up. Space battles are now managed in real-time RTS mode.

[*] - Faction wars have been balanced with the addition of new features.

[*] - A new station combat mechanic has been added to the game. When organizing operations, players can now determine the outcome of ground force battles and manage group force fights inside stations to capture or plunder them.

[*] - Post-war designs for all stations have been completed and added to the game. The type of battle now affects station interiors accordingly.

[*] - The Battle Steps system has been removed now that war tactics are implemented during the battle itself and the battle organizing interface has been simplified.

[*] - The entire main story has been reworked. We have removed missions that received the most negative feedback and replaced them with new ones.

[*] - All main story mission details and descriptions have been rewritten. Balanced rewards have been added for all missions.

[*] - The main story has been extended with the addition of unique missions.

[*] - To address player complaints about getting stuck on missions, we have added hints and helper videos for the most challenging objectives.

[*] - The ability for players to build their own stations has been added to the game. Players can now add new floors to their Faction's capital stations and design the interiors themselves. They can also share their stations with other players, and these stations are playable by others. This feature also marks the beginning step towards mod support.

[*] - The option to customize modules, weapons, and components while on a ship has been added to the game. This addresses one of the most requested features; players can now change their ships' weapons, components, and modules in space through the main interface (this feature is not available on capital ships).

[*] - The in-game experience and item reward system have been balanced. Experience and rewards for side and guild missions have been increased.

[*] - New traveling Space Markets have been added to every solar system. Players no longer need to enter stations to shop.

[*] - Game sounds have been adjusted, and new music has been added to the game.

[*] - New Stations, buildings, markets, new character models, new mission locations, sounds, effects, animations, interfaces, and tutorial videos have been added to the game.

[*] - Enemy AIs in space battles have been rewritten and are now much more performance-friendly. we can now conduct battles up to 100vs100 with significantly better performance. Therefore, battles suitable for crowded combat scenarios have been added to the game.

[/list]


[h3]**BUG FIXES:**[/h3]
Reported by players as follows:

[list]
[*] - The ship manager panel sometimes displays my ship's inventory incorrectly or deletes other inventories.
[*] - I can't deactivate my character's Slow Time skill after it's activated until all energy is depleted.
[*] - Some character skills are not working.
[*] - My save games are duplicating, and loading duplicated save files deletes my main story save.
[*] - Opening the Bug Report interface while the pause menu is open and then closing it causes game controls to stop working.
[*] - A line comes from some asteroids while mining, and if I warp shortly after, the line does not disappear.
[*] - I can buy ships cheaply and sell them at a high price, allowing for unlimited money earning.
[*] - Ship interfaces disappear if I open the Scanner during takeoff while docked at a station.
[*] - I cannot land on planets, or the planet surface appears dark when I do.
[*] - If I exit my ship using the G key while using a Stargate, my ship goes to the other system, but I stay in the original system, halting game progress.
[*] - If I save the game during warp after calling my space squad, loading that save duplicates my squad soldiers.
[*] - Selling captured prisoners gives me “0” money.
[*] - Even if I mute all sounds, some weapon sounds are not muted.
[*] - The game crashes if I open the scanner or Atlas while performing a system jump.
[*] - AI attacks on my station do not end until I arrive at the battlefield when I am far away.
[*] - Every time I add soldiers to a battle where the AI attacks my station while I am away, enemy forces reset to their initial strength.
[*] - After rescuing Momo and returning to our base, attempting to talk to her again repeats her dialogue from the previous mission, and she self-destructs.
[*] - If I switch directly from aim mode to Sniper rifle aim, my character's head remains visible and obstructs my field of view.
[*] - If I interact with an object (like a door) while the sniper scope is open, the scope remains on the screen until I close the game.
[*] - The ship equipment tutorial does not progress despite following the instructions exactly.
[*] - I hit an invisible wall at the mission location for the first Mining station mission and cannot complete the objectives.
[*] - I cannot board ships on the deck of Motherships.
[*] - Some weapons on Motherships are placed right in the middle of the ship, either making them unable to fire or causing them to hit my own ship.
[*] - If I land on a planet surface with a ship taken from my Mothership and save and load, my Mothership is sent to a point outside the solar system.
[*] - Executed faction wars sometimes reset, and I have to arrange the battle again.
[*] - My character remains invisible if I activate the Jetpack in first-person camera mode.
[*] - I can exit my ship with the G key while landing on a planet, but the ship continues moving to unreachable areas.
[*]- If the usable modules of a ship drop to zero, the icon appears corrupted on the ship HUD, and if I reload the modules, the new stack number shows up on the HUD, but the icon remains corrupted.
[*]- In a faction war, after locking onto the battlefield from the Escape route, if I head to a stargate instead of warping, the battle commences.
[*]- During faction wars, I am unable to destroy certain ships (such as Enemy capital ships or motherships).
[*]- Battle sounds continue to play even after I have moved away from the battlefield.
[*]- Some rockets hit my own ship after being fired.
[*]- The missile warning sound continues to play even when there is no missile following me, and the sound doesn't stop until I close the game.
[*]- My ship is not repaired when I land at stations, especially at Falron stations.
[*]- During side missions, end-mission NPCs are spawning twice in the same location. If I talk to both, I receive the end-mission reward twice.
[*]- At high screen resolutions, the main interface appears on the right side of the screen, not in the center.
[*]- Certain enemy types do not spawn in quests found randomly on planet surfaces through POIs (? icons), preventing quest completion.
[*]- I could not control my ship if I opened the pause menu while performing a battle warp during combat.
[*]- I was able to duplicate items in the ship management interface by quickly switching between cargo slots.
[*]- "Fuel" trade item in my inventory do not appear on the sales screen when trading in the galaxy trade center.
[*]- I cannot use some energy-consuming skills even when my character's energy level is full.
[*]- Enemies spawned in some Mercenary Guild missions are extremely unbalanced and impossible to kill.
[*]- Playing with the Resolution Scale setting in options causes all game graphics to distort, and the issue persists until I restart the game.
[*] - The sky does not appear on some planets or appears underground of the planet surface.
[*] - In the Faction structures section, the same stations appear duplicated 2-3 times.
[*] - Some mission descriptions are missing or misleading.
[*]- Experience rewards from main missions are displayed on the main screen but are not being added to my character.
[*] - I do not receive XP from killing soldiers in ground battles or receive very low experience.
[*] - Quick switching between the Scanner and Space Atlas causes small interface windows to remain on the screen until I restart the game.
[*] - AI from factions other than mine sometimes attack our stations in AI vs. AI battles.
[*] - The sound of my spaceship's Laser weapons continues looping if I exit the ship while firing and does not stop until I board the ship again.
[*] - Electric weapons do not deal damage to some enemy types.
[*] - Exiting a station causes the interior level not to be destroyed, and warping in this state either crashes the game or drastically drops FPS.
[*] - If I switch back to tactic view after executing a battle, the operation appears to be ongoing, but no battle is visible when I arrive.
[*] - Using a sniper rifle once in a save causes me to enter FPS mode even without a weapon in subsequent instances.
[*] - If I enter through the capital door of Morthra stations, I can use the jetpack inside, and sometimes I fall through the station.
[*]- Some Ground AI enemies remain in place even after their health drops to zero, and their death animation plays a few seconds later.
[*]- I experience significant FPS drops during warps after departing from some planets.
[*]- Starting a quick load (F8) without taking a quicksave or after deleting existing Quicksaves initiates the game on an empty map.
[*]- The doors to enter outposts sometimes disappear, preventing access to the outpost interiors.
[*]- At Independent stations, if I rapidly enter and exit, I find myself unable to re-enter through the same door.
[*] -Fixed dozens of minor bugs related to the interface and level design, along with various small glitches throughout the game. 
[/list]

**NOTES:**

[olist]
[*] We believe we have fixed the most reported game-breaking bug, the Warp Crash issue. If you still experience crashes with this update, please share your save files with us on Discord to accelerate our troubleshooting.

[*] We are completely redoing the Bounty system in the game, but unfortunately, it did not make it into this update. Therefore, bugs related to the bounty system are still present. We will transition to a brand-new bounty system with the next update, eliminating all related bugs.

[*] Similarly, we are overhauling the Raid system, so bugs still exist in that system. These will be resolved with the transition to the new raid system in the next update.

[*] We regret to announce that we have to postpone the Bank Heist missions announced in the trailer for some time.

[*] Due to significant changes in the game's dialogues and texts, we haven't been able to add the new translations to the game yet. Therefore, in this version, many texts will only be available in English. We plan to resolve this issue with upcoming updates.
[/olist]

notes.title: SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 3.0.0 Released
notes.content:
[b]SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 3.0.0 [/b]

• Main Story Extended
([i]Part of the new features are related to the main storyline, therefore to avoid spoilers, they will not be published here.[/i])

• Sub-House Management: Players can now create and manage sub-houses under their own faction. Players will have to maintain diplomatic relations not only with their own faction but also with sub-houses. 8 main sub-faction diplomatic decisions have been added to the game.

• Soldier Train Camp Added: Players can now quickly level up 4 soldiers by sending them to the training camp via the barracks at the capital station.

• NP Faction Intelligence Improved: NP factions AI has been enhanced with new features.

• AI Wars Added: AI factions can now engage in wars with each other. Players and their factions can directly influence these wars. Players can participate in AI vs. AI wars individually or with their faction and change the course of the battle.

• Faction Wars Balanced: Faction wars are now more challenging.

• Support Buildings Activated in Faction Wars: Capturing and holding support buildings can change the course of the war.

• New Crew Members Added.

• Ground Combat AI Improved: The AI for ground combat has been improved (still under development, but smarter than before).

• Texture and Overlays Optimized: Many poor-looking textures have been updated.

• AI Facial Morphs and Dialogue Animations Improved: AI characters' lips now move in sync with the dialogue text.

• Planet Landing and Surface Loading System Improved: It is now more performance-optimized and less bug-ridden. This should also fix bugs related to mission areas not spawning on the planet's surface.

• General Game Optimization: Projectiles, effects, shadows, and high frame rate animations have been optimized to prevent crashes due to performance issues.

• Diplomatic News Tab Added: Players can now follow diplomatic news and wars from the diplomacy interface.

• Landing Port Added to Player Faction Stations, for Motherships, and other big class Ships.

• New Soundtracks by TrapMusic Industry: 2 new environmental music tracks (for guilds and some stations) have been added. Many thanks to them!



[h3]BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[i]Reported by players as follows :[/i]

• Some wars never end, regardless of whether I win or lose.

• If there is a war in a system, war starts even if I warp somewhere other than that battlefield.

• During a battle, if the battle ends while performing a "battle warp", the ship is stuck in the battle warp sequence. Cannot return to generic gameplay.

• My squad can sometimes attack me or ally ships.

• If I open the pause menu while quick saving the game, the save sequence is paused, and if I save the game from the menu at that time, both save files become corrupted.

• Bullet guide indicators stuck on the screen if the target ship is too far away.

• When a station is attacked, if I save/load the game within 4 seconds after the attack starts, I automatically win the war.

• If I leave large ships in the center of independent Faction stations and go inside, I cannot enter some areas in the interior. The ship's collision affects the inside of the station.

Motherships function similarly to floating stations, featuring numerous consoles found within stations Like armory, market, upgrade console etc. Additionally, Motherships come with exciting new perks.

[b]New Ground Squad ( Nova Squad)[/b]

Nova Squad is a ground squad, which will join the player in ground combat, just like Alpha Squad. Players can now summon this squad to fight alongside them during ground combat scenarios.
Within the squad, players have the ability to assign four areas of specialization to the soldiers. These specializations include Medic, Tank, Reaper, and Blitzkrieg.

A new drone management system has been added to the game.

Additionally, drones have been balanced, and the maximum number of drones that ships can carry has been increased from 8 to 15.

[b]Limb Damage and Gore System:[/b]

The ability to inflict damage to different limbs has been added for ground combat.

notes.title: SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 1.4.0 Released
notes.content:
[b]SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 1.4.0 [/b]

[h3]NEW FEATURES AND CHANGES :
[/h3]

[list]
[*] Raid mechanics have been added to the game. Players can now organize raids on systems.

[*] System conquering mechanics have been changed. To conquer a system, players will need to organize a raid on that system. ([i]It will not affect the systems you currently have.[/i])

[*] Plunder Raids have been added. Players can now organize raids on trade convoys within systems to collect faction resources.
[i]Please watch the "Raids" section in the Video Tutorials panel for more information.[/i]

[*] The Capital Station system has been improved. Each faction now has one capital station, and additional station models and interiors have been added for other player-built stations.

[*] New structures can be built at the Capital Station to enhance faction abilities: 

[*] [b]Medic: [/b]Reduces the chance of soldiers dying in combat and adds a "wounded" status to soldiers.
 [b]Barracks:[/b] Adds a new general slot to the faction army.
 [b]Intelligence: [/b]Allows advance warning of attacks on stations.
 [b]Marketplace: [/b]Adds markets to the station (not yet visually implemented in the game).
 [b]Weapons: [/b]Upgrades the weapons of soldiers and ships.
[i]Note: The interior designs for the new station sections have not been implemented yet, but their bonuses can still be used in this update.[/i]

[*] New policies and tax collection features have been added for non-human residents of stations captured by factions.

[*] Players can now assign faction missions received via email to their freelancer soldiers. Previously, these missions had to be completed by the player themselves. Now, players have the option to assign these missions to their freelancer pilots. This feature provides more flexibility for players and allows them to delegate faction missions to their team of skilled freelancers.

[*] A new "Sell Ship" feature has been added to ship markets.

[*] A "Sell All" button and feature have been added to all markets to enable players to sell multiple class items at once.

[*] Ore prices have been adjusted to make mining more profitable. [i] The Ores currently in your cargo will not be affected by the new prices. The new prices will only affect Ore gathered after this update.[/i])
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[i]Reported by players as follows :[/i]

[list]
[*] During a battle or raid, generals can be removed from their duties. In this case, even though they won't appear in the interface, they will still remain on the battlefield.
[*] If a general is removed from their the slot in Faction interface, the indices in the Member section get mixed up, making it impossible to select a general from the list.
[*] I can’t close the elevator widget while in the Capital Station “ Close” button doesn’t work
[*] In the Faction Structs section, the daily production always appears as 14/d
[*] Sometimes AI attacks occur in situations where I cannot intervene. (For example, in a planet surface dungeon.)
[*] When moving around for a long time or sometimes when waiting for a long time on certain planets (mostly unique planets that are part of the main mission), the shadows become very dark.
[*] If AI attacks a place and I am inside that system at the time, the battle does not start. If I exit and re-enter the system, the battle starts.
[*] The "Tools" resource produced in the factories that I captured is not being added to the faction resources at the end of the day.
[*] In the Koron Lab mission, after finding Koron, I can progress to different parts of the cave. But when I reach the end of the cave and enter a room, I can't exit, the game gets stuck at that point.
[*] Sometimes when I exit a planet's surface with my ship, the exit sequence ends, but then the landing sequence starts again immediately.
[*] If I try to drag and drop one of my wingmen as a soldier under another general in the faction interface, the operation fails. However, after closing and reopening the interface, my soldier is permanently lost.
[*] Security forces countdown doesn't disappear when you leave the area and fighter spawns even if you're in a station
[*] When I load the ship with two different weapons of the same class only one of them fires. (We were unable to reproduce this bug, but we believe it occurs when the game is played in languages other than English. Therefore, we have made some changes. If you still encounter this bug, please let us know.)
[*] Sometimes during faction battles, I can see detailed progress bars of distant ships. This not only blocks the view from a cosmetic perspective but also has a significant performance impact.
[*] Sometimes after destroying enemies, their PODs spawn inside my ship even if I’m far from the battlefield.
[*] If I change the location of the soldier I assigned to an AI attack in the faction interface, soldiers with the name "None" appear in the battle interface. 
[*] The barricade perk doesn't activate on the first press even though I have enough energy. It only becomes active after pressing it a few times.
[*] In some stations, I am able to interact with multiple interactable objects at the same time. For example, the Weapon Market interface and the Ship Components interface open simultaneously and even if I close one of them, I cannot close the other.
[*] When I scan with probes in the scanner interface, sometimes I find empty points. When I warp to these points, the warping process never ends.
[*] In the Molyax mission, if I close the game before Molyax leaves the ship after joining the team, he remains in the team but the mission doesn't progress.
[*] Some Soldier missions don't reward anything at the end. (We couldn't reproduce this bug, but we made some changes to ensure that rewards are given. Also, we want to remind you that raiding villages doesn't offer any rewards.)
[*] Sometimes my soldiers die in battle but they don't disappear from the Faction interface. In these cases, when I change the dead soldier's slot, they rejoin the army as level 1.
[*] Some Pod's gives empty prisoners 
[/list]
 

[b]We also have some exciting news:[/b]

As a solo game developer, I understand the importance of providing a bug-free gaming experience to all of you. However, with so many reports and feature requests coming in,  it's easy to miss a few. That's why I'm excited to announce that I have enlisted the help of a professional consultant named Gabeux to assist me with bug analysis and tracking.

With Gabeux's help, We'll be able to work more efficiently and provide quick resolutions to any issues that may arise. If you encounter any technical problems with the game, please don't hesitate to contact Gabeux. He will be available to help with any problems you encounter. 

Thank you all for your support :)

[i]Note 2: If the player attacks a high-level faction or a faction with many allies in previous versions, they may have difficulty defending their stations.

[h3]BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[i]Reported by players as follows :[/i]
• The game crashes at the end of the Jump (We have optimized and/or changed several warp effects for this bug and have been testing on multiple machines for the past 3 days without encountering any crashes. Therefore, we assume this bug has been fixed. If you still encounter this bug after this version, please let us know.)

• The game crashes in the robot parts collection section of the Rebuilding a Friend mission before capital ships arrive.

When taking off, the Services screen will appear, and the ship will remain landed, usually resulting in a bug or crash in the ground or landing pad. 2. Land normally (new landing). Press R (Takeoff) once. Wait a few seconds. The ship will take off, and the Landing UI will remain stuck in the player's view.
• All faction soldiers leave the army at once.
• Initializing Operation at Escape Route does not work if I save/load at the Escape Route in that system.

• The Signal Disruptor perk sticks as active, does not disable and drains all energy.

However, in the game, every turret loaded onto the ship puts 2x turrets on the ship, and the fire rate is divided between these 2 guns. Consequently, each turret fires once every 0.5 seconds. [b]SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 1.2.0 [/b]

[h3]NEW FEATURES AND CHANGES :
[/h3]
[list]

[/i]

notes.title: SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
[b]SpaceBourne 2 Early Access Ver. 1.1.0 [/b]


[h3]NEW FEATURES AND CHANGES :
[/h3]
[list]
• New stations have been added. Independent faction stations are now accessible.
• The entire main quest spawn system has been changed. We expect the issue of quest points not spawning, especially in different languages, to be completely resolved.

Also; We would like to clarify this issue as we have received numerous reports regarding it:
If your soldiers are leaving the Faction, please check if the path you have chosen for the Faction and the changes you have made in the Constitution is in line with that path. 

For example, if you have chosen the Order path and set the Neutral Civil Policy to "Kill on sight", your soldiers' loyalty will decrease and at some point, they will leave the army.

Also, please make sure that the Organization's Reputation is in line with the path you have chosen. You can also track why your soldiers are leaving the army from the Faction reports.

If everything is in line with this mechanic and the soldiers are being removed from the list, but nothing is written in the Faction reports, then there may be a bug. Please report this issue in that case.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all Early Access players for their support. Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us improve the game. Thank you!
